# Invaders

> Invaders is a free cinematic arcade shooter that runs in the browser: fly anywhere in the lower half of the screen, shoot down alien formations and beat a boss at the end of each of 14 worlds, 70 levels in all.

Each world has its own look, music and twist. Power-ups (spread shot, laser, rapid fire, shield, homing shots, slow time; a second one waits in reserve while the first runs), smart bombs and extra lives drop along the way. The thirteenth world, Sunset Armada, adds wingmen (two escort fighters that fire with the ship for 10 seconds) and a broadside twist: catch a pickup and the ship's side guns fire left and right for 6 seconds. The fourteenth world, Ember Carnival, has a fireworks twist: some invaders are shells, and a shell shot down bursts and sets off the invaders around it. After every cleared level the game cuts a movie trailer from the player's own run, re-simulated from the recorded inputs; the Cinema on the title screen keeps the best run of every level, and a lost level plays a short blooper. It is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript ES modules with no dependencies, no build step and no network requests at runtime. Made by Babak Bandpey at Cocode, released under Apache-2.0.

## Play

- [Invaders](https://invaders.cocode.dk/): the game itself; keyboard or mouse
